scope: Architecture-only AR traffic census at position1048575, TP96. No hardware build, throughput measurement or adoption claim. Main matrix total is complete for emitted mv instructions; local-operator parameters separately bounded, not silently omitted.
checkpoint_format_authority: tools/arch_budget_v41.py:193-201 and docs/ARCH_SPEC_V41.md:370: FP8 codes plus one UE8M0 scale per32x32; FP4 packed E2M1 plus one scale per32; wo_a stored FP8 although executed BF16. No source payload precision change.

local_weight_obligations.note: HC projection and wk are inside local ops, absent emitted mv count. Keep HC/norm/scalar parameters resident locally to achieve main-stream bound. Norms, HC scale/base, sink/bias, Engram q/k vectors, embedding and selected Engram table rows remain additional small parameters/lookup obligations, not included in main matrix byte total. HC logical input is4x5120 BF16 =40960B, unlike maximum SM operand16384B.

mandatory_serial_body_cuts_per_layer: x projections gather before q normalization/projections
grouped wo_a golden subtree reduce before wo_b
attention output gather before next residual
expert intermediates gather before down projections
FFN output gather before next layer
collectives.qualification: 270 emitted collective operations are NOT270 mandatory serial roundtrips: Engram/index/candidate branches may overlap. Six base body cuts/layer are mandatory for this fixed W19 ownership, not a universal lower bound over all legal partitions. all_reduce bytes is8192 FP32 result values; eight subtrees provide262144 input bytes before reduction. Program topk payloads are flat union counts, not minimum hierarchical-select link traffic.

remote_storage_architecture.necessary_bound: T >= total_weight_bytes / sustained_aggregate_storage_to_compute_bandwidth; additionally each dependency interval must receive its required slices before use.
remote_storage_architecture.explanation: All selected w1/w3/w2 slices become addressable at the same router result: one retrieval initiation per layer, not1103 serial read roundtrips. Dense weights can be prefetched if enough local buffers and sustained bandwidth. Down weights can prefetch alongside gate/up compute. Each added unhidden storage first-byte delay costs up to40 times that delay. No HBM PHY/bus assumed.
remote_storage_architecture.break_even: Capacity/compute decoupling wins latency only if compute/placement time saved exceeds unhidden weight-transfer time + added first-byte delays + changed collective time. If transfer has no overlap, B_required = bytes / saved_time; with overlap model each dependency interval individually.
remote_storage_architecture.local_vs_remote: Global96 ranks with compute next to locally-owned weights move activation/results across rank fabric. Separate dumb ROM storage moves~12.876GB main weights per token across an additional fabric. The compute rank collectives remain in both unless ownership changes; remote storage does not inherently remove them.
remote_storage_architecture.excluded: KV/index SRAM/HBM traffic, link encoding/ECC/headers, contention, startup, return tail, physical wire flight, buffering, package power and MTP are not part of byte-rate lower bounds.

operand_transport_note: The BF16 byte columns are logical element-count envelopes, not permission to round a FP32 prequantization operand to BF16. Exact linear_q transport can carry its already-produced FP8 codes plus UE8M0 per32 and any Folded scalar, or unchanged FP32 prequantization values. mv/linear_bf16 consume explicitly BF16-rounded values plus any separate Folded scalar. All counts omit descriptors/identity/flow-control overhead.
summary: 12.8759808GB is the complete emitted main-matrix stored-format payload, not every parameter byte in the network. Add locally resident HC and other small-parameter obligations according to placement; remotely streaming96 replicated copies of all HC matrices adds15.0994944GB/token.
